title: Kalooki
openingHint: Your first meld(s) must total at least {{n}} points

tutorial.table: Each player lays melds (sets/runs) face up on the table. Your first meld must meet the opening points shown at the top.
tutorial.hand: Pick cards from your hand to build meld groups. Jokers act as wild cards.
tutorial.actions: Draw → meld/lay off → discard one card, in that order.

frontendHint.kalookiTakeDiscard: The discard connects with your hand — take it
frontendHint.kalookiDrawStock: The discard connects with nothing — draw from the stock
frontendHint.kalookiOpenFirst: You have not opened yet — the threshold has to be met in one go, so keep building
